    <div>
      <h1>Pre-Mortem: Which of the 19 Failure Modes Will We Hit?</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">A ranked organizational risk register — typically the top five to seven failure modes, each with a named owner and a dated mitigation.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-20-nineteen-failure-mode-premortem</b><br>
      Pack G - The plan we leave with<br>
      fill order <b>2</b> &middot; type <b>diagnostic</b><br>
      audience <b>mixed</b>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-source">
    Source: <b>Anti-Patterns and Failure Modes</b>, <i>The Taxonomy</i> &middot;
    <code>handbook/ch20-anti-patterns-and-failure-modes.qmd</code> L14-42 &middot;
    <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch20-anti-patterns-and-failure-modes.html#sec-anti-taxonomy">#sec-anti-taxonomy</a>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    Score each mode individually before reconciling. Record likelihood, impact, any cited incident, blast radius, the control you have, the gap to build before the pilot, one committed mitigation, its named owner and landing date. Tick “Seen it already” only with a reference. A Low likelihood needs a named existing control. Record any difference from the book's severity in Blast radius. A Band 1 row without a mitigation is a go/no-go item.
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block" style="margin-bottom:1.5mm">
    <h2>Shared risk scale <span class="ws-block-note">use the same vocabulary as WS-08-pitfall-risk-register</span></h2>
    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1.5mm;font-size:7pt;line-height:1.15">
      <div><b>Likelihood</b> &mdash; High: already seen, or a named precondition is present today. Medium: no local precedent, but current practice would not prevent it. Low: a named existing control would catch it before harm; name it in Control we already have.</div>
      <div><b>Impact</b> &mdash; Critical: corrupts the codebase or crosses a trust boundary, discovered late or not at all. High: costs a wave or sprint of rework, or loses confidence. Medium: costs hours, visible at the next checkpoint. Low: an irritation absorbed inside the normal loop.</div>
    </div>
    <p style="font-size:7pt;line-height:1.1;margin:1mm 0 0"><b>Watch band:</b> Band 1 = High likelihood with Critical or High impact; Band 2 = any other pairing containing Critical or High; Band 3 = everything else. No weighting, multiplication or numeric score.</p>
  </div>
